description:
FILED s540a (Opus agent, 2026-11-13) from the CPAN board timing (#4787; docs/cpan-speed-comparison-s540.md section 4 row 10).

WHAT: in the run-phase profiles of YAML-PP t/43.indent.t, 20.dump.t, 21.emit.t (05806e16, scratch/s540a/prof-05806e16/), 18-28 % of the run is CL `search` called from cl-ppcre's scanner (create-scanner-aux: the regex's constant-prefix search), with sb-kernel:vector-hairy-data-vector-ref/check-bounds 8 % self -- the GENERIC element accessor, i.e. an untyped `search`; Mojo-DOM58 dom.t shows the same (search 12.8 %).  YAML::PP's lexer consumes its input IN PLACE with `$$yaml =~ s/\A...//` (38 substitutions in Lexer.pm) and its emitter escapes with s///eg.

DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENTS (TAKEN):
* REFUTED: a string built by .= (an adjustable buffer) is NOT slower to match than a literal copy -- scratch/s540a/micro/matchbuf.pl, 40,000 x m//g over 900 chars: PCL buffer 0.192 s / literal 0.183 s (perl 0.122 / 0.125).
* CONFIRMED, length-proportional: scratch/s540a/micro/searchlong.pl, inside-program times, three runs each (scratch/s540a/micro.log, a bounded leg at load 1.5-4, code 05806e16): 2,000 matches of /key: (\w+)/ whose prefix is at the end of 50 KB: perl 0.001 s, PCL 0.068-0.071 s (the same on 1 KB: perl 0.000, PCL 0.002-0.003); 2,000 x `my $s = $long; $s =~ s/key: /K=/`: perl 0.004 s, PCL 0.378-0.382 s.  perl finds the literal with its Boyer-Moore / memmem path and copies $long copy-on-write; PCL scans element by element through the generic accessor and copies and rebuilds the 50 KB string per substitution.

LEVER candidates (measure each on the micro + YAML-PP 43.indent.t): (a) a typed simple-string search (or Boyer-Moore) for cl-ppcre's start-string -- the ONE regex engine stays (DECIDED), only its prefix search is specialised; (b) `s/\A...//` as an in-place chop of the leading part (perl's OOK), so a lexer that consumes its buffer is not quadratic; (c) the full-string copy per s/// on a fresh copy.  Board seconds are small (~4 s: YAML-PP + Mojo run phases), but every text-processing program that keeps a long buffer pays it.  Size: one session for (a); (b) needs a design note.
subject: PERF: a match / substitution on a LONG string pays its whole length every time -- 2,000 x s/key: /K=/ on a 50 KB string: perl 0.004 s, PCL 0.38 s (95x); 2,000 x /key: (\w+)/ finding a late prefix in 50 KB: perl 0.001, PCL 0.070 -- cl-ppcre scans the constant prefix with the generic CL `search` (hairy element reads), 18-28 % of YAML-PP 43.indent / 20.dump / 21.emit
